lines.text: The people have wearied the LORD by saying that all who do evil are good in His sight.
The LORD of Hosts says He will send His messenger to prepare the way before Him.
The Lord will be like a refiner's fire and will purify the sons of Benjamin like gold and silver.
After the refining, the offerings of Judah and Jerusalem will please the LORD, as in days of old.
The LORD will draw near for judgment against those who deny the foreigner justice and do not praise Him.
